title: wkfind: Multi-keyword code search with GlobCoverageScore ranking
desc: Smart keyword extraction (skill-search compatible) with PHRASE/AND/OR tier ranking, git diff auto-detection, time-range fallback, and parallel triad analysis
steps: Tokenization: split each user arg by Unicode regex [^\p{L}\p{N}]+ (non-letter/non-digit). Result has two lists: keywords (tokenized sub-strings) and rawPhrases (original args, lowercased).
Token-length filter: include sub-tokens only when length > 1 AND sub-token != original lowercase arg. Original lowercase arg is always added to keywords first.
phraseNorm vs phraseRaw: phraseNorm = keywords joined by space (used when arg count > 1); phraseRaw = rawPhrases joined by space. Both substrings are checked for in-order containment.
baseScore (GlobCoverageScore): for each keyword present in fieldLower, score = token.Length / field.Length. Final baseScore = average of all matched-token scores. No matches => 0.

Tier multipliers (skill-search compatible): PHRASE (phraseNorm or phraseRaw substring present in field) => baseScore x 2.5. AND (every keyword present, any order) => baseScore x 1.5. OR (any single keyword present) => baseScore x 1.0.
Tier classification at display: score >= 2.4 => PHRASE; 1.4 <= score < 2.4 => AND; 0 < score < 1.4 => OR. OR tier capped at 10 displayed rows.
Time-range fallback: --day -> --week -> --month -> --year -> --unlimited. Threshold = 3 matches (hardcoded minResultsThreshold). Each broader range is a superset, so total replaces (not accumulates).
Git diff auto-detection: if $env:TEMP\wkfind-git.diff exists, set searchPath to that file and skip the time-range fallback chain. Source label switches to 'git diff + TRIAD'.
suggestions.jsonl noise filter: skip grep result lines that match BOTH (suggestions.jsonl|\"ts\":|\"from\":|\"text\":\") AND (BUG-AUTO|DG-wkappbot) to avoid suggest-history flooding the results.

Search backend: wkappbot file grep <firstToken> --path <searchPath> -i (ripgrep underneath, .gitignore-aware). First keyword only is used for grep; all keywords are used for scoring against each matching line.

Session search: wkappbot session list --claude --cwd, parse [claude] lines, extract MM-DD date + HH:MM time + title. Filter by the same time-range cutoff used for code. Score titles via Measure-SkillSearchScore. Top 3 are shown.
Year inference for sessions: parsed MM-DD is compared to current date; if greater than now, assume previous year so the date stays in the past.

Triad parallelism: wkappbot ask triad is launched via Start-Process before search begins; output streams to a temp file. Default timeout 60s, override via $env:WKFIND_TRIAD_TIMEOUT. Process is intentionally NOT killed on timeout to preserve the in-flight response.
Output: --output <file> writes JSON {timestamp, search_terms, time_range, total_matches}. Triad insights are always streamed to stdout after the code+session report.
Usage: wkfind [--day|--week|--month|--year|--unlimited] [--output file.json] <kw1> [kw2] [kwN]. Range flags accept --, -, /, or suffix forms (e.g., --day, -day, /day, day).
